newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos officials seek port ruling reversal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos officials seek port ruling reversal.

text.p: Officials from Brazil's Santos port were to meet the president of the lower house of Congress to discuss pressing through a bill reversing a ruling at the root of a port strike this week, the port said.
"There will be a meeting in the office of Deputy Michel Temer in Sao Paulo at 1730 local/2030 GMT," said a spokeswoman for the port authority.
The meeting would include the president of the port authority Codesp, Marcelo de Azeredo, as well as deputies and union representatives.

They were to discuss a bill by Deputy Vicente Cascione to reintegrate the private terminals of steel mill Companhia Siderurgica Paulista (Cosipa) and another firm, Ultravertil, into the port structure.

A ruling allowing company workers of Cosipe to conduct loading and unloading at Cosipe's private terminal at the port triggered a stevedores' strike there Wednesday which spread to several other Brazilian ports by Friday.
Unions argue only registered and qualified stevedores should be allowed to conduct these operations.
